assessment.governing_intent: Deliver WO-220505 as a bounded live liveness replacement proof for SF-REQ-056, including phase-1 isolated operational mechanics proof and phase-2 authorized real #125 lane recovery proof, without retiring the bootstrap mechanism or mutating unrelated BIUs.
implementation_unknowns: Exact implementation details for the Python monitor_host read-only identity-checked adapter over Node claim, Issue result, Project status and health evidence.
Exact implementation of the generation-bound CanonicalEffectAdmission consumer that delegates the bounded Project mutation and gated Producer B claim reservation to the single authorized Node writer.

Whether current Node cycle accounting can represent the fresh-generation transition and Producer B claim reservation without repair; if not, the authorized focused Node repair must be designed and proven.
How exclusive writer custody will be mechanically established and retained for the bounded live window given GitHub Projects lacks compare-and-set semantics for updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue.
Crash, timeout and resume behavior across persisted Node recovery steps must be implemented so ambiguous Project readback holds rather than fabricates attribution.
Exact evidence capture locations and immutable observation references for commands, exits, remote mutations, claim reservations, readbacks, duplicate refusal and bootstrap restart receipts.
Operational timing and orchestration details for stopping bootstrap liveness, observing the G+I real gap, performing the recovery, restarting bootstrap liveness and gating Producer B launch.
material_risks: The live phase intentionally pauses the bootstrap liveness service; failure to restart and read back the watch-start receipt would be a material operational hazard and stop condition.
GitHub Projects does not provide an expected-version field, so attribution depends on exclusive writer custody, durable step recording and readback discipline rather than atomic CAS.
A mistaken implementation could mutate or claim an unrelated BIU despite the stated blast-radius limit to Issue #125 only.
The bridge crosses Python monitor_host, canonical admission, Node writer behavior, Project mutation, dispatcher claim reservation and systemd/bootstrap orchestration, creating coupled failure modes.
If real Node/Project/health evidence is unavailable or ambiguous during preflight or recovery, the work must hold rather than infer an empty or passing state.
Cycle accounting and launch-gate handling may require Node repair; an incorrect repair could accidentally launch Producer B too early or erase cycle-1 history.
Timing-dependent live proof could fail to observe the required real gap within the bounded window, yielding incomplete evidence rather than acceptance.
assessment.next_action: Hand off to Producer A continuation to implement the in-scope bridge and admissible phase-1 receipt, then proceed through the defined Director preflight/live-window/Producer B/independent verifier sequence only if each required readback and custody precondition is satisfied.
assessment.rationale: READY is the controlling disposition because the text reports that the material owner decisions have been made: predecessor status, operational authority, phase-1 target, phase-2 real workload target, acceptance rule for the #125 lane, budget/custody, and bounded Node-change authority are all specified. The remaining gaps are primarily engineering design, integration, orchestration and verification details within the stated node scope. The work is technically large and spans multiple components and actors, but it is governed by one acceptance predicate and one recovery proof outcome; splitting it would risk separating the mechanism, live evidence and verification that must be judged together. No supplied fact establishes an unavailable external prerequisite at readiness time, although the plan correctly treats unavailable live evidence or exclusive custody at execution time as a hold.
assessment.summary: The submitted work presents a cohesive BIU with fixed authority, target binding, execution custody, acceptance predicates, evidence obligations, and a sequenced PRODUCER/Director/PRODUCER/VERIFIER plan. Owner-level questions previously identified are reported as disposed, and remaining uncertainties are implementation and operational preflight matters rather than unresolved product or authority intent.
assessment.verification_assessment: Acceptance is observable if the retained evidence shows both the pinned phase-1 isolated operational fixture and the phase-2 real #125 lane exercise: healthy independent scan, actual G+I gap, canonical admission, one fenced Project recovery mutation, direct readback, duplicate-effect refusal, provider/judgment suppression, one-writer proof, bootstrap restart/watch-start, and exact outcome receipts. A single independent verifier verdict is meaningful because JC is instructed to retrieve the final SHA in a fresh worktree and judge the retained phase-1 and phase-2 evidence against the same bounded predicate. Offline-only, synthetic-only, NO_GAP_OBSERVED, shortcut relaunch, or missing readback evidence cannot satisfy the acceptance predicate.
